title: cairn operator show artifact renders a ticket that carries decisions as a numbered list on one screen, and a ticket without decisions renders as it does today
intention: _format_ticket in cairn/tools/operator_inbox/inbox.py reads ticket_version(doc): v2 iff str(doc.get('schema_version') or '') starts with ticket-v2, else v1. A v2 ticket prints the standing header, INTENTION (owning_intention as one address line), DECISIONS (one wrapped 'n. text [by]' entry per line), QUESTIONS (only when non-empty) and BERTHS (intent_berth, sorted_berth, chart_claim), in at most 60 lines at width 76. A v1 ticket prints exactly what it prints today, and gains a DECISIONS section after MEASUREMENTS and before QUESTIONS only when it carries a non-empty decisions list.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendell: grep for ticket_version and ticket-v2 over cairn/ and skills/ outside proofs returns nothing; _format_ticket on a ticket with decisions prints no decisions at all; the v1 baseline of ticket 8754ae677af6 renders 38 lines from the unedited renderer
traces_to: Law 5 (the address carries what a mind needs NOW: the ticket's prose is the trail); CP4 designing to the tool (two readers who do not infer from prose); Law 3 (the v1 render is pinned by a baseline measured before the edit); Law 8 (the v1 tooth must be able to fail).
how: One new function ticket_version(doc) and one v2 branch in _format_ticket; the v1 path is not edited. The proof test_operator_inbox.py gains test_format_ticket_v2_one_screen and test_format_ticket_v1_byte_identical, the second against a baseline captured from the unedited renderer and committed beside it (proofs/fixtures/v1_ticket.json, v1_render_baseline.txt).
